description: Printed PETG slanted step-up sized to the Line 6 4-switch modeler chassis (254 x 152). The Step Up's architecture, scaled up: front leg, sloped deck, rear leg, over a 3 mm base plate that carries the retainer clips. The deck is slotted so a modeler plate with QuickMount retainers drops on.

datum.origin: centre of the base footprint, on the board-facing face
datum.y_axis: across the depth, +Y toward the high edge of the deck
datum.z_axis: away from the board, toward the pedals

envelope.height_note: scaled to the modeler: 264 x 176 leaves a 5 mm end margin and a 12 mm side margin around the 254 x 152 chassis

height.note: the low edge stands base 3.0 + clearance 3.0 + the retainer's 15.89 loop drop; the 9 deg slope then lifts the high edge by 176 x tan(9)

base.note: behaves like a 3 mm QuickMount plate: integral clips hang below it and its top face is the floor of the body

top.sheet_note: 4.0 rather than the board's 3.0 so the retainer's 4.0 ledge sits flush under the sheet with no foam pad; slot, rib and pitch are the board's

slot_field.note: measured in the deck's own plane; a true 34.0 grid, so the pedal plate's retainers land on whole pitches anywhere along the deck

top.layout_note: ribs at -51, -17, 17 and 51 leave slot rows at -68, -34, 0, 34 and 68; three 60 mm slot columns give the plate somewhere to sit anywhere along the length

body.note: every rib sits under solid sheet, never under a slot; ribs are clipped by the sloped body prism so each stops on the deck's underside at its own height

clips.note: 102.0 apart, which is 3 x the board's 34.0 pitch, so both clips land on ribs. The blade points outboard, so the closed window frees it while the post stays fused to the plate

board.note: 18 mm slot + 16 mm rib; the Cinque drawing prints it, the retainer config's 33.43 pair pitch is a different board and is not used here

target.pedal: Line 6 DL4 / FM4 / MM4 / DM4 / AM4

fabrication.print_orientation: base plate on the bed, the sloped deck rising last; the clips overhang and want supports
fabrication.supports: under the two clip loops only
fabrication.note: printing base-down keeps the clip mouths open with no bridging; the deck's slots print as short horizontal bridges

envelope.source: ../line6_modeler/cfg/line6_modeler.json: 254 x 152, r9.5; riser sized 264 x 176 to leave a margin

height.source: derived from the retainer section's 15.89 loop drop plus a 3.0 base and 3.0 clearance; lands within 0.3 of PedalRiser-L's printed 49

clip_placement.source: ../commons/cfg/retainer.json section; positions chosen 3 x 34.0 apart so both clips sit on ribs

open_questions: No QuickMount type covers the modeler chassis, so no plate exists to drop on yet. The slot field is a generic 34.0 grid; the modeler plate must be generated with its retainers on rib centres first.
The 9 deg deck is a starting point, not a measurement. Set deck_slope_deg to 0 for a level deck.
The 238 x 136 M3 pattern would let the modeler bolt to a plate, not to this riser directly: the plate has to hang between the screws and the riser.
